counterexamples: D(S(x*y)) contracts to x*y and to D(S(x)*y); both are irreducible and evaluate equally
notes: Same obstruction as Add: D∘S=id overlaps S-distributivity. D-through-Mul and I_a-through-Mul are unsound. Add+Mul still contains the Add peak and was not a separate system.
statement: The unary tree TRS plus exact push-in S(x*y)→S(x)*y (and N through Mul) is locally confluent.
title: Unary plus push-in S through Mul is locally confluent
